matching.primary_key: settlement_utr matched against bank chq_ref_no, then against the UTR embedded in the bank narration

deductions.note: input tax credit, not a cost

adjustment_rules.when: gateway row type == 'refund' inside the batch
adjustment_rules.action: add the refund debit back before comparing the batch to sales, expect a Credit Note in the daybook

adjustment_rules.when: gateway row type == 'dispute' with credit_type 'dispute' and debit > 0
adjustment_rules.action: treat as a batch deduction, expect a Chargeback Suspense debit in the daybook

adjustment_rules.when: a later dispute row credits the same dispute_id
adjustment_rules.action: clear the suspense, link across settlement batches

adjustment_rules.when: payment.on_hold is true and settled is false
adjustment_rules.action: exclude from the batch, do not expect a bank credit, flag revenue cut-off if a Sales voucher already exists

adjustment_rules.when: two or more bank rows carry the same UTR
one bank row narration says CONSOLIDATED
adjustment_rules.action: allow one bank credit to clear more than one settlement batch

escalation.unresolved_after_rules: raise as an exception with the source file, the amount, the closest candidate match and the reason no rule applied
